question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM **of the given word.

**Abundance**
solution:
The correct answer is Option (4): **Meagreness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abundance"** means a very large quantity of something; it signifies plenty or profusion. **(बहुतायत)**

 
 
• **Example: **There was an abundance of food at the wedding, enough to feed all the guests twice over.
 
 
 
• **"Meagreness" **refers to the quality of being small in quantity or meager; it is associated with insufficiency and scarcity, the opposite of abundance. **(अल्पता)**
 
 
• **Example: **The meagreness of his salary made it difficult to cover all his monthly expenses.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Abundance' **is **'Meagreness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Meagreness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Miser** (कंजूस)**:** A person who hoards wealth and spends as little money as possible.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite his wealth, he was a miser who lived far below his means.
 
 
 
• **Unpleasantness** (अप्रियता): The state of being unpleasant in nature or experience.
 
 
• **Example: **There was an air of unpleasantness in the room following the heated argument.
 
 
 
• **Non-serious** (गैर-गंभीर): Lacking in seriousness or not being earnest about an issue.
 
 
• **Example:** His non-serious attitude towards his studies cost him a year at college.
